name: vector-dither
title: Vector Dither
description: A gradient or an image turned into an ordered or pattern dither and rendered as inline SVG: one shape per cell, grouped by color, crisp at any size.
label: Shpigford dither
author: Josh Pigford <https://github.com/Shpigford>

loop.script: click[2] → wait → click[3] → wait → click[0] → wait → click[1] → wait

props.name: src
props.description: An image to dither, read once with a 2D canvas (same origin, CORS or a data URL). Without it a generated gradient is dithered. The image shows until it is read.

props.name: gradientAngle
props.description: Angle of a linear or conic source, in degrees.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the generated source in pixels (the SVG's viewBox); cells = width / cellSize.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the generated source in pixels. Default: the width (1:1).

props.name: mode
props.description: Blends a linear or radial ramp into the brightness (30%).

props.name: ditherStyle
props.description: Full cells, or cells sized by darkness (upstream's `style` setting; renamed because `style` is React's).

props.name: angle
props.description: Angle of the linear mode ramp, in degrees.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the radial mode ramp, in percent.

props.name: offsetX / offsetY
props.description: Center of the radial mode ramp, -100 to 100.

props.name: palette
props.description: A preset or colors from darkest to lightest; the last color is the background.

props.name: percentages
props.description: Share of the brightness range per color; the last is adjusted so they sum to 100. Default: the preset's, or equal shares.

props.name: alt
props.description: Describes the picture; without it the dither is decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown while an image loads or when it cannot be read.

a11y: With alt it is role="img" with that name; without it the dither is decorative. The SVG itself is aria-hidden.
A gradient source renders on the server: the static page already shows the real SVG. Nothing moves, so reduced motion needs no change.
An image source shows the plain image until its pixels are read, and keeps showing it (data-status="unsupported") if a cross-origin image cannot be read.
usage: <VectorDither palette="sepia" pattern="halftone" shape="circle" alt="A sepia halftone ramp" />
